scope.summary: Repair live_oracle::live_top_queries_resolves_source_and_runs_including_statspack_fallback so it proves the b37214d8 Diagnostics Pack license gate instead of asserting a bare successful historical resolve: unattested history is asserted to be a typed PolicyDenied refusal, and the operator-attested path is exercised against the real instance posture with real AWR rows.
out_of_scope: No production code changed: the license gate in crates/oraclemcp-db/src/awr.rs was intentionally tightened by b37214d8 and is not modified, bypassed or weakened here.
crates/oraclemcp-db/src/catalog_query.rs, health.rs and connection.rs are untouched; connection.rs and scripts/*_lint.sh dirt in this shared checkout belongs to other agents mid-edit.
The test is live-only (feature live-xe) and was re-executed manually on the three local lanes, not in a scheduled CI lane.
The Statspack branch is retained and exercised only by the resolver's fallback/Unavailable arms; no lane has PERFSTAT installed, so the populated-Statspack real-data path was not exercised live.

entry_points.name: oracle_top_queries historical=true (AWR/Statspack license-gated path)
entry_points.trace: live_oracle::live_top_queries_resolves_source_and_runs_including_statspack_fallback re-run on free23/xe18/xe21 via cargo +nightly-2026-05-11 test -p oraclemcp-db --features live-xe,oracledb --test live_oracle -- --nocapture --test-threads=1 live_top_queries with ORACLEMCP_LIVE_XE=1 => 1 passed; 0 failed on each lane. Unresolved-attestation historical resolve returns DbError::Refused(ErrorClass::PolicyDenied) naming the Diagnostics Pack, and resolve_top_sql_source_with_license(..., true, true) selects AwrAsh and returns 5 ranked rows (dba_hist_sqlstat 7337/2597/2910 rows). Raw output in tests/artifacts/evidence/live/oraclemcp-4eyms-3lane-20260928T0901Z.json.

limitations: Live proof is manual local-lane execution (free23 23ai, xe18 18c, xe21 21c) as SYSTEM, not a scheduled CI lane; python-oracledb 4.0.2 and the thin driver are the only clients exercised.

All three lab lanes report control_management_pack_access=DIAGNOSTIC+TUNING, so the attested arm resolves to AwrAsh everywhere; the Statspack branch (PERFSTAT installed, pack inactive) and the Unavailable branch were not reached live. Their typed behaviour remains covered by the awr.rs unit tests (attested_but_unavailable_pack_falls_back_to_statspack, licensed_history_with_both_catalogs_absent_degrades_to_typed_refusal).

The refusal assertion is about the operator license attestation, not the instance parameter: because the parameter is DIAGNOSTIC on these Free/Express lanes, the test specifically proves that technical activation alone does not satisfy the gate. It does not attempt to prove commercial licensing of any lane.
Only the scoped cargo test / clippy / rustfmt gates were run in this lane; no workspace-wide required-proof graph was executed.
